subject: SIG: Ephemeral HSM validation and transit encryption proofs
messages:
From: Tekla Compliance <compliance@tekla.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:34:00 -0500
Subject: SIG follow-up — ephemeral HSM usage and transport proofs

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As part of our SIG review we need a concise artifact set demonstrating how Redwood uses ephemeral HSM-backed keys for in-transit protections and key lifecycle controls. To keep scope tight, can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2028-11-30)?

1) A short statement (PDF) describing where ephemeral keys are generated and how the HSM attestation chain is verified (we do not need source, just architecture + control points).
2) Sample rotation ledger (scrubbed) showing at least three rotation events for ephemeral keys used in transit. CSV acceptable.
3) TLS configuration and cipher list used for service-to-service connections (include minimum TLS version and any mutual-TLS configuration).
4) A redacted operator shift log excerpt (one week) showing HSM operator actions related to ephemeral key ceremonies.
5) Any HSM vendor attestation or hardware certs you can share (FIPS/CC or vendor attestation).

Notes: we understand some items will be redacted; mark any sensitive fields and provide a short rationale for redactions. Also include a link to a shared folder where the artifacts will be uploaded and a contact if we need an encrypted channel for larger files.

Thanks — Jose Ramirez (Tekla)
Compliance Manager
Tekla Financial

Attachment: tekla-evidence-template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tekla Compliance <compliance@tekla.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — ephemeral HSM usage and transport proofs

Jose — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the items requested. Quick summary of what we'll provide and the delivery plan: 

- Architecture statement (PDF) describing ephemeral key generation (HSM-backed EPHE keys), attestation checks, and where zeroization occurs.
- Rotation ledger (CSV) with three redacted rotation events; we will redact tenant IDs and replace with tokens like <TENANT-REDACTED>.
- TLS/service-to-service cipher list (txt) showing mTLS endpoints between control plane and serving runtime; minimal TLS v1.3 required.
- Operator shift excerpt (redacted) showing operator IDs hashed; includes timestamps and action types.
- HSM vendor attestation PDF (we will include the vendor-signed attestation and redaction summary).

We will upload artifacts to a secure Drive folder and share a link (see below). For anything considered CII we will provide hashed placeholders and a short explanation so your review team can validate control completeness without accessing secrets.

Delivery ETA: first batch uploaded by EOD tomorrow (2028-11-29), follow-up attestation documents by 2028-11-30. If you prefer transfer via SFTP, tell us and we'll provision a one-time SFTP user.

Shared folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tekla-ephemeral-hsm
Contact for encrypted transfer: irene_choi@redwood.ai (Security Ops)

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: hsm-attestation-2028-10.pdf (pdf), ephemeral-key-rotation-summary.csv (csv), transit-tls-cipher-list.txt (txt)

Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Tekla SIG artifacts — owner assignment and redaction checklist

Irene / Ben — forwarding Tekla's request (below). I agreed to upload a first batch by EOD tomorrow. Can you please own the following pieces?

Irene: please prepare the architecture statement PDF and the vendor attestation. Work with HW team to confirm attestation file and include short note on verification steps. Mark any HSM serials for redaction.
Ben: please extract a rotation ledger for ephemeral keys used in transit for the last 6 months, scrub tenant IDs, and provide a CSV with a short column mapping (timestamp,event_type,previous_key_id,new_key_id_redacted). Include one sample operator shift excerpt (hash operator IDs).

Also: legal asked that we include a short redaction rationale doc describing each field we scrubbed. I'll draft that and drop into the Drive folder. If either of you need SFTP for the vendor attestation let me know — I can request a one-time credential.

I put placeholders in the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-tekla-ephemeral-hsm

Thanks — V

Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — ephemeral HSM usage and transport proofs

Vanessa — received the Drive link and the first batch. Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications after a quick pass: 

- The rotation ledger format is fine; can you add a column for rotation_trigger (automated/policy/incident)?
- For the TLS cipher list, Tekla's eval team expects explicit confirmation that internal RPCs enforce mutual TLS and that client certs are short-lived (<= 24h). A sentence in the architecture statement is sufficient.

If you can update those two items in the folder by EOD tomorrow we'll mark this item as complete on our side. If not, please let us know the ETA.

Appreciate the notes on redaction — the rationale doc looks good.

— Jose
